checks.detail: T6 TaskSpec envelope binds allowed_files (ticket receipt, validation receipt, two independent reviews, task report, completion receipt, campaign_metering.py, campaign_controller.py, test_control_plane_campaign_metering.py, test_control_plane_campaign_controller.py), forbids production campaign/control-plane modules outside the owned pair, data/KBase, scheduler/ACL, user files, run_research*.py, and all non-owned tests; payload_sha256 matches canonical serialization.

All fourteen input evidence references hash-match the live repository: P6 approval, scope manifest, implementation baseline, and T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 task reports and completions; baseline_sha256 matches implementation_baseline.json.

The only tracked source changes are the new campaign_metering.py, the modified campaign_controller.py, and their two owned test modules; data, KBase, strategy, policy, scheduler/ACL, user files, and all other control-plane modules are untouched.

ResourceObservation is a frozen dataclass with non-negative bounded counters (0..2**63-1), canonical payload round-trip, deterministic sha256 identity, and fail-closed validation against reservation limits.

complete_model_execution accepts one deterministic ResourceObservation and freezes tool_attempts/data_exposures/disk_growth_bytes into the operational execution usage identity inside the active-execution transaction; observed tool attempts must equal the durable usage attempt inventory and over-limit observations fail closed with BudgetExceededError.

p7_authorized=false, campaign_authorized=false, final_holdout_authorized=false, auto_advance=false; no real data/KBase read, no scheduler/ACL mutation, no daily update/backtest/research/campaign/holdout started.

advisories.detail: When no observation is supplied, complete_model_execution derives tool_attempts from the durable usage attempt inventory and keeps data_exposures/disk_growth_bytes at zero, preserving legacy behavior while making the default deterministic.
The operational_execution_usage.v2 schema is retained; the observation is bound through the existing tool_attempts/data_exposures/disk_growth_bytes fields so adopted history replays unchanged.
